title: General.
officialText:
Sidewalk cafés provided beyond the building line shall comply with the requirements of this section, the New York City Zoning Resolution, the Commissioners of the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection and Department of Transpor-tation, and with the projection limitations of Chapter 32 of this code.
*Section 3111.1 was amended by Local Law 80 of 2020. This law has an effective date of August 28, 2020.
